facts.text: I will ask specific questions/points.
I will answer a question using the information provided and add a brief description of each member.
I am presenting an organization called Ethereum México.
The organization’s mission is to educate more people to learn to use blockchain technology securely while transmitting Ethereum values.
The organization’s mission is to inspire people in Mexico to build in Web3.
The organization positions itself as a bridge between the Ethereum ecosystem, the Ethereum Foundation, and other communities in Mexico.
The organization’s vision is to be a main access point for people who want to learn about Web3/Ethereum and to provide tools for people to participate and build in Ethereum.
The organization plans to continue its alliance with the Ethereum Foundation and bring at least 100 Ethereum builders in 3 years (developers) and 300 (non-tech).
The organization aims to be an incubator of Ethereum Mexico communities.
The organization aims to help with the management, organization, and promotion of events for Ethereum Mexico communities.
The organization aims to be a reliable and close medium for disseminating high-quality Ethereum content in Spanish.
The organization aims to support local communities to learn about Ethereum and provide tools so more people in Mexico can build in Ethereum.
The organization’s added value is that the Ethereum Mexico team provides a defined entity that supports local communities and people across the country.
The organization’s added value is that it contributes to building communities and new projects related to Ethereum.
The organization is hosting an event called Ethereum Mexico in Mexico City.
The Ethereum Mexico event is scheduled for September 30th.
The Ethereum Mexico event targets an audience of 1200 people.
The Ethereum Mexico event will include talks and workshops.
The Ethereum Mexico talks and workshops aim to educate attendees on web3 and the current status of the ecosystem.
The Ethereum Mexico talks and workshops aim to cover more complex topics such as future updates on Ethereum.
The Ethereum Mexico talks and workshops will be offered in Spanish.
The Ethereum Mexico event is intended to be accessible for people who want to learn from scratch about Ethereum.
The organization plans to reach out to universities and smaller communities across Mexico to participate in the event.
The organization plans to launch a Quadratic Funding Round with the EF.
The Quadratic Funding Round is intended to help secure more funding for public goods in Mexico.
The proposed work aligns with the EF’s mission and scope by focusing on community building, education, and strengthening the Ethereum ecosystem foundations.
The organization’s grant scope problem includes creating an event for Mexican people who can’t afford to go to other cities of the world to attend an Ethereum event.
The organization wants Mexican people to learn that the web3 ecosystem is not only about crypto.
The event described is the first Ethereum México created and focused in a community-backed event.
